messages:
Ravi N: Quick sync after yesterday's incident. We need concrete owners for remediation tests: expanded regression promptset, targeted tokenization evals, nightly load/soak, small chaos drill for KV GC, and a replay harness. Goal: owners + short timelines by EOD.
Elena G: I can take the regression promptset and the tokenization buckets. Plan: extract error traces, dedupe, add ~150 adversarial prompts, plus 250 synthetic variants. Will produce prompt json + eval harness PR by Tue EOD.
Tom W: I'll own load/soak + replay harness. Proposed soak: 90m at 140 rps on staging, with a 15m 4x spike. Replay harness will allow exact request sequences from logs to run locally. ETA infra PR by Wed.
Ravi N: Who can run the chaos drill (KV GC pause and a worker eviction) and own rollback steps? We should run in an isolated pool and have SRE observe.
Elena G: I can coordinate the chaos artifact set and acceptance criteria, but need SRE for the actual eviction. Suggest Fri 02:00 UTC for minimal staging interference.
ops-bot: Created ticket TEST-18422 "Post-incident: evals & remediation tests" and assigned Ravi N, Elena G, Tom W. Link: https://redwood.internal/TEST-18422
Tom W: Acceptance criteria proposal: regression = no >1.5% drop in primary quality metric on adversarial bucket; tokenization eval = <0.5% increase in tokenization error rate; soak = p95 < 200ms and retries <0.3%; chaos = successful recovery within 20m with no persistent KV inconsistencies. If any fail, auto-flag TEST-18422 for blocker triage.
Elena G: For regression runs, baseline with prod decoding config and run one sampling variant (top-p=0.92) to catch sampling-sensitive diffs. I'll include thresholds in the PR.
Ravi N: Tom, can you add telemetry guards to the soak job for token-rate and kv_gc_pause_ms? If token-rate >30% for >2m, fail the job and alert.
ci-bot: Scheduled nightly job "incident-soak" in staging-ci for 03:00 UTC with tags [soak, incident].
Tom W: Will add telemetry checks and upload dashboard widgets. Also adding a replay command snippet in the PR: 
```
./replay --from-log incident-2026-03-18.json --speed=1x --target=staging
```
Elena G: I'll prepare the adversarial promptset and small deterministic eval harness (exact-match + normalized-levenshtein). Draft by Tue EOD as noted.
Ravi N: Chaos drill plan: simulate KV GC pause + worker eviction in isolated pool Fri 02:00 UTC, SRE oncall will observe, ops runbook will include kv flush, snapshot-restore, and worker-replace commands. Post results and short customer blurb next day.
ops-bot: Linked TEST-18422 to SRE-4281 and scheduled a 1h runbook review Wed 16:00 UTC.
Tom W: I'll ensure the replay harness is deterministic and include a small test-run in CI so we can repro locally before soaking.
Elena G: One last note: include an "adversarial-origin" tag on prompts derived from incident logs so we can track regressions separately.
Ravi N: Owners recap: Elena = prompts + tokenization eval (PR Tue EOD), Tom = soak + replay + telemetry (PR Wed), Ravi = chaos coordination, runbook, and comms. I'll update TEST-18422 with acceptance criteria and owners now. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
